headline: You’re losing money by increasing size after a loss

size_up_after_loss.why_it_matters: Increasing your entry size after a loss cost you ₹1,05,732. The after‑loss trades resulted in a loss of ₹1,95,375 and a win rate of 28%, compared with a win rate of 39% otherwise.
size_up_after_loss.rule: After a loss, your next entry is your usual size.

averaging_down.note: Adding to losing positions is emerging, so keep an eye on it.

closing: Consider applying the rule above in the coming month.
